notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Bridge from Below and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return the nontoken creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
